title: Normalize compact error semantics and fallback policy
objective: Make Go compact failures surface the same categories and recovery behavior as TS instead of silently truncating or wrapping all errors generically.
implementation_scope: Define typed or sentinel errors for not-enough-messages, user abort, incomplete response, prompt-too-long, API error summary, and no-summary response.
Ensure user abort/cancellation does not fall back to truncation.
Ensure manual /compact surfaces compact errors with user-friendly text.
Remove normal HistorySnip fallback for LLM summary errors unless explicitly designated as an emergency path and separately messaged.
Ensure reactive compact failure returns the withheld original provider error where appropriate.
Add tests for each error category and fallback branch.
out_of_scope: Do not change provider retry policy except for classifying compact-related errors.
Do not alter unrelated command error handling.
acceptance_criteria: Manual compact no longer reports success after silent last-4 truncation on LLM failure.
Prompt-too-long compact retry exhaustion returns the TS-equivalent prompt-too-long compact error.
User cancellation preserves cancellation semantics and does not mutate history.
Incomplete summary response is distinguishable from provider API error text.
risks: Users may see failures that previous fallback hid; this is necessary for parity and correctness.
Error strings may be consumed by tests or UI, so prefer typed errors plus stable display mapping.
dispatch_prompt: Normalize Go compaction error categories and fallback policy to match TS, eliminating silent success-through-truncation for ordinary compact failures.
